message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll typically find on a chocolate‑cake shopping list:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for an ~8‑inch round cake) |
|------------|-------------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | **1 ¾ cups** (220 g) – sifted for lightness |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | **⅔ cup** (70 g) – gives deep flavor |
| Granulated sugar | **2 cups** (400 g) – sweetens and helps structure |
| Baking soda | **½ teaspoon** (≈2 g) – leavening agent |
| Salt | **¼ teaspoon** (≈1 g) – balances sweetness |
| Buttermilk (or plain milk + lemon juice)** | **1 cup** (240 ml) – adds moisture & acidity |
| Vegetable oil (neutral‑flavored) | **½ cup** (120 ml) – keeps crumb tender |
| Eggs | **2 large** (about 100 g total) – bind everything together |
| Vanilla extract | **1 tsp** (5 mL) – enhances overall taste |
| Boiling water | **½ cup** (120 ml) – activates cocoa, creates steam |

> *Optional extras:*  
> • Cocoa nibs or chopped dark chocolate for texture  
> • A splash of espresso or coffee concentrate (a few teaspoons) to deepen chocolate flavor  

These amounts will give you a moist, rich chocolate cake ready for frosting or simple dusting!
